posts.text: Berat's white Ottoman houses climb the hillside, and in the evening the windows light up one by one. The Berat Wine Weekend is 2 nights with breakfast, the Berat day tour with a wine tasting and the return transfer from Durrës, from EUR 149 per person in a twin room. Travel 20 November to 20 December. Book by 30 November.

posts.text: Berat Wine Weekend, from EUR 149 per person in a twin room. It includes 2 nights with breakfast, the Berat day tour with a wine tasting, and the return transfer from Durrës. You can travel on any date from 20 November to 20 December 2026, and the booking deadline is 30 November 2026. Come to our office in Durrës or write to us to choose your dates.
